correctness.rationale: The exact FGM joint density integrates to f_S(s)=lambda exp(-t)[t+theta B(t)], B=t-4+4(t+1)exp(-t), t=lambda s. Independently differentiating yields curvature numerator F=-1+theta[4t(t+1)e^-t-2]+theta^2[-1+4(t^2-3t+4)e^-t-16e^-2t]. The source proves theta<=0 by negative concavity cross terms, and for theta>=0 rules out violations at t<=1. For t>1 its strictly negative quadratic term Q and monotonic F(t,theta)/theta^2 on 0<theta<=1 yield a unique possible violation threshold per t. Compactness at a sub-unit level yields the attained theta*=inf r(t), so not merely a numerical optimization. Independent symbolic expansion and numeric minimization corroborate theta*=0.8602582730974543 at t=1.64184454095; log4, theta=1 gives F>0. The lambda rescaling and endpoints theta=-1,0,1 have been checked.
